selection: Highest validation macro F1; larger L2 wins exact ties. Test is not used for selection.
deployment_rule: Retain contrast unless adaptive fusion exceeds every existing head and both fusion controls on validation macro F1.
objective: Class-balanced training out-of-fold negative log likelihood plus 0.5*L2*sum(gate slopes squared). Gate intercepts are unpenalized.
features: For each expert: entropy/log(4), top-two margin, maximum score; three pairwise total-variation distances; cosine distance of normalized global/crop embeddings. Standardize with training out-of-fold means and std clipped below at 0.05.
caution: Exploratory follow-up after the existing test results were known. Expert C=10 was selected in the earlier validation study; this is not nested cross-validation. Mixtures of experts are established, not a new architecture.
